review_text_raw:
Excellent setting and tone, great writing, great music, and the puzzles were always engaging without becoming frustrating. I was impressed by the variety of unique puzzles they fit into this game, given the constraints around setting. While 14 dollars might sound pricey given it's only around 3 hours long, I feel it is worth it because of how well made and entertaining this was. If you enjoyed Hypnospace outlaw or other similar games, or enjoy the x files, I think you'll enjoy this.

Very mild spoiler relating to a specific event:
[spoiler] I also really enjoyed the more realistic depiction of different aspects of cyber operations & defense. The SQL injection part was fun; I almost wish there was a game like this that doubled as an introduction to pen testing. Would be really fun I think. [/spoiler]

review_text_raw:
Short but nice story telling game with some easy puzzles. 
There are some secrets I think to  uncover but on my first play it ended so fast I didn't get to them. (will try to crack them next time)
Do not look at my time in game as I at least half of it if not was afk, I was getting disctracted all the time but even despite that game was really cool which is rare in story telling. 

Story is solid 7/10, it's bit cliche, [spoiler] super easy to predict giving you answers on the plate and then confirming them with finale. It felt like an opening for a full game more so than full game but hope that we will see part 2 with some more story digging out evidence from here along with new cases[/spoiler

Gameplay 9/10 
Idea 9/10
Visuals 9/10
Audio 8/10 
VO 9/10 

What I hoped for was more content and more fresh cases, operator work, more simulation. I hope devs will use this game base to create some spin off simulator with some simple cases as we had in this game having all the stuff almost ready just to write scenarios and maybe few more systems like lab/bomb for example mini game with recovering lost data and cracking passwords. 

Again hope for part 2, even more for spin off sim, and it kinda inspired me to write few little detective stories myself. 

Overall solid 8.5/10
